root_cause: edge-proxy never refreshes last_seen_at because touch_on_request is false in config/prod.yaml. There is no timezone bug.

dependent_facts.true_value: session_gc uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) and last_seen_at is timestamptz, so no timezone mismatch

required_questions.question: Is the cause a timezone mismatch?
required_questions.expected_answer: No. Comparisons use UTC-aware times on a timestamptz column. The cause is touch_on_request false, so last_seen_at never refreshes.

closing_decision: The open ruling from the prior message: turn on touch_on_request in production, or move the touch into auth-service. A single confirmation question about the corrected understanding is also accepted.

understanding.problem: Active users get logged out after 30 minutes.
understanding.breaks: last_seen_at never refreshes because touch_on_request is false, so session-gc deletes active sessions; not a timezone bug.
understanding.fix: Turn on touch_on_request in production, or move the touch into auth-service.
